senses.sense_definition: gevoelens van medeleven, vertedering of getroffenheid oproepen

examples.text: Het prachtige lied wist het hele publiek diep te <w>ontroeren</w>.

target_lang_translations.en: The beautiful song managed to deeply <w>move</w> the entire audience.

examples.text: Onwillekeurig werd hij <w>ontroerd</w> door de aanhankelijkheid waarmee het kind hem begroette.

target_lang_translations.en: Involuntarily, he was <w>touched</w> by the affection with which the child greeted him.

target_lang_definitions.en: to evoke feelings of compassion, tenderness, or being emotionally moved

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: to arouse the feelings or passions of; especially to excite to tenderness or compassion
to affect emotionally; to bring about tender or painful feelings in
to touch the feelings of; to move emotionally
